heroHeadline: Lisbon Two-Night Run Complete — 130,000 Fans at Estádio da Luz; Madrid 10-Night Residency Opens May 30
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny closed his first-ever Portugal stadium concerts on May 26–27 at Estádio da Luz in Lisbon — two sold-out nights drawing ~130,000 fans, the largest Latin music event in Portuguese history. The DtMF World Tour's European leg now advances to Madrid, where an unprecedented 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano opens May 30 — the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history (550,000+ projected attendees, €300M+ economic impact). That same day, the Adidas x Bad Bunny Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) goes on wide release via Adidas Confirmed, timed to the Madrid opening. 'DtMF' holds 60 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the all-time chart record — with the 61st-week chart due May 30. The *Porto Rico* epic film (directed by Residente, co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production with principal photography expected late 2026.
